description: Ahp Decision Maker is a multi-criteria decision support tool that uses the AHP (Analytic Hierarchy Process) method. It allows you to define criteria that should be maximized or minimized and, based on this, calculates the percentage preference for each option, helping you identify the best choice. If you need any support, send an email to: dev@wead.tech Or visit: https://ahpbi.wead.tech/en
